label: 半导体设备（含泛半导体）业务
definition: Issuer source-native semiconductor-equipment business including pan-semiconductor LED/display equipment. Group business revenue includes relevant subsidiary activity; not silicon wafer, dicing, debonding or HBM equipment revenue. Do not sum with 大族半导体 subcompany revenue.

label: 大族半导体营业收入
definition: Issuer-reported revenue of 大族半导体, a named consolidated subcompany/business, reported within the parent issuer perimeter. It overlaps the broader semiconductor/pan-semiconductor equipment business and is not an additional standalone market total; no dicing or HBM allocation.

label: 报告期末母公司和主要子公司在职员工
definition: Year-end active employee total for Han’s Laser parent and principal subsidiaries as explicitly labelled; not automatically every entity in the consolidated group.

label: PCB 智能制造装备
definition: Source 分产品 row for PCB intelligent-manufacturing equipment. Outside semiconductor equipment, so it sits in all_businesses and cannot roll into an SME category. H1 2026 amount equals the PCB reportable segment and the listed subsidiary 大族数控.

label: 其他智能制造装备
definition: Source 分产品 residual after PCB: holds semiconductor, consumer-electronics, new-energy and general laser equipment together. The filing does not allocate it, so it is never a semiconductor numerator.

label: 境内
definition: Source 分地区 row 境内 in the 营业收入构成 table; partitions total operating revenue. Parallel to 分产品, never crossed with it.

label: 境外
definition: Source 分地区 row 境外 in the 营业收入构成 table; partitions total operating revenue. Parallel to 分产品, never crossed with it.

label: 报告分部：激光
definition: H1 2026 p177 reportable segment 激光, before 分部间抵销. Includes semiconductor equipment but is not semiconductor-only and does not partition reported revenue without the elimination column.

label: 深圳市大族半导体装备科技有限公司
definition: Legal-entity row in the principal-subsidiaries table. Kept apart from hans_laser_hans_semiconductor_subcompany_business, whose 大族半导体 narrative figure differs for the same half, so the two perimeters are not the same. Not additive to group revenue.
